sloka: विज्ञाप्यश्च नरव्याघ्रो रामो वायुसुत त्वया ।अखिलेनेह यद् दृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी ।। ५.६५.२० ।।।।
transliteration: vijñāpyaśca naravyāghro rāmo vāyusuta tvayā ।akhileneha yad dṛṣṭamiti māmāha jānakī ।। 5.65.20 ।।।।

translations.english: (She said)'O son of the Windgod you should let Rama, the tiger among men know all that you have seen here.
